metadata.name: AME2026 evaluated ground-state reaction energies

papers.title: The AME2026 atomic mass evaluation (I), input data and adjustment
The AME2026 atomic mass evaluation (II), tables and references

quantity_transformations.BE: A × published BEA; not independently read from AME

metadata.value_columns: A[1:4], element[5:8], Z[8:11]; reactions six 18-character blocks; each includes value and uncertainty tokens; * denotes missing
metadata.flags: # is source-estimated and replaces decimal point; * missing never equals zero
metadata.uncertainty_scope: Official evaluated marginal 1-sigma uncertainties with AME mass correlations retained; no diagonal-error substitution

validation.central_value_tolerance: Sum of half-last-printed-digits from each surviving mass coefficient and published value, plus 1e-8 numerical slack; no uncertainty-derived tolerance
validation.uncertainty_comparison: Not compared to independent mass propagation: published evaluated uncertainties retain AME correlations; New/model propagation is a different calculation.
